description: Na₂LuWPO₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibca space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.89 Å. Lu is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.41 Å. W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.80 Å) and two longer (1.84 Å) W-O bond lengths. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Lu, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one W atom.
